standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme-level standard fpqc axioms
standard_prerequisites.use: The assembled family over Z is a standard fpqc covering.

standard_prerequisites.name: Openness of surjective etale morphisms of schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: surjective etale morphisms of schemes are open (cross-chapter, structural)
standard_prerequisites.use: Finite affine opens W_j of U x_X Z cover Z.

core_obligations: Forward: if {X_i -> X} is fpqc then {U x_X X_i -> U} is fpqc by the base-change axiom.
Converse: for h: Z -> X with Z affine, U x_X Z -> Z is surjective etale, hence open; pick finitely many affine opens W_1..W_t covering Z.
Over each W_j apply the assumed fpqc property of {U x_X X_i -> U} to W_j -> U: a standard fpqc covering {W_{jl} -> W_j} refines {W_j x_X X_i -> W_j}.
Assemble: {W_{jl} -> Z} is a standard fpqc covering of Z (scheme-level axioms) refining {Z x_X X_i -> X}; conclude.
proof_roadmap: Base-change direction; finite affine chart reduction on the scheme side; per-chart standard fpqc refinement and assembly.
difficulty_reason: The converse direction with the finite affine chart reduction is a genuine detection argument.
